linkedin.heading: What does an AI bot actually run in a real business, day to day?
linkedin.body:
What does an AI bot actually run in a real business, day to day?

I counted. 28 jobs across two businesses I own, and 10 are worth copying.

Seven in the morning, it test-calls our AI sales reps and scores every answer out of 100 against the wording I approved. At nine, it emails 150 businesses. In the afternoon it ships fixes and new pages to the website. At four, it follows up the people who showed interest.

A few that matter most:

→ Two AI sales reps that make real calls, say they're AI and look up approved answers mid-call
→ A full-time rep for about £752 a month, about £377 realistically
→ 150 emails every weekday, which found 5 warm leads on 22 October
→ 14 new industry pages in one go, built and put live on its own

And the part that makes it safe: anything public waits for my yes. Emails, guides and fixes run on their own. Posts, outreach changes and new wording for the reps do not.

The full countdown is in the video, link in the first comment.

Which job would you hand to a bot first?
